verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents API versioning or a deprecation policy for the Sandbox SDK. The only change-related note is that ReadableStream support in writeFile() "replaces the 'base64' encoding option", which describes a single feature change, not a versioning scheme or deprecation policy. The platform-wide openapi.json probe says nothing about versioning or deprecation either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
